cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(jailtools LANGUAGES CXX HIP)

# Specify C++ standard
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED True)

# Enable this manually via: cmake -DENABLE_LLVM_COVERAGE=ON ..
option(ENABLE_LLVM_COVERAGE "Enable Clang-based coverage instrumentation" ON)

if(ENABLE_LLVM_COVERAGE)
  message(STATUS "Building with Clang coverage flags enabled")

  # Check if using Clang
  if(NOT "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID}" MATCHES "Clang")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ENABLE_LLVM_COVERAGE requires Clang")
  endif()

  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping -O0 -g")

  # Set output directory for raw profiling data
  set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} -fprofile-instr-generate")
endif()


option(BUILD_TESTS "Enable unit tests" OFF)

if(BUILD_TESTS)
  # === GoogleTest setup ===
  include(FetchContent)
  FetchContent_Declare(
    googletest
    URL https://github.com/google/googletest/archive/release-1.12.1.zip
  )
  FetchContent_MakeAvailable(googletest)
  enable_testing()
endif()

# Add libraries
add_subdirectory(libs/batch_generator)
add_subdirectory(libs/utils)
add_subdirectory(libs/sparse)
add_subdirectory(libs/network)
add_subdirectory(libs/multiplex)
add_subdirectory(libs/parallel)
add_subdirectory(libs/file_io)
add_subdirectory(libs/rank)
add_subdirectory(libs/normalize)
add_subdirectory(libs/correlate)
add_subdirectory(libs/rwr)
add_subdirectory(libs/timer)
add_subdirectory(libs/split)
add_subdirectory(libs/sort)
add_subdirectory(libs/sampling)
add_subdirectory(libs/stats)
add_subdirectory(libs/elbow_point)

# Add apps
add_subdirectory(apps/rwr)
add_subdirectory(apps/rwr_perturbation)
add_subdirectory(apps/rwr_ablation)
add_subdirectory(apps/grin)
add_subdirectory(apps/shortest_paths)
add_subdirectory(apps/rwr_loe)
add_subdirectory(apps/clean_edge_list)
